recommended_pricing_model_rationale: A pilot removes trust friction. If the brief materially improves pricing or leasing messaging, a recurring monthly intelligence report is easier to renew than a pure software subscription.

pricing_benchmarks: Yardi Matrix uses subscription pricing based on markets and users.

The value must be framed in leases, occupancy, or pricing decisions rather than general research quality.
